# Loca8tor

> Loca8tor turns any address into a precise, shareable postcode and powers delivery workflows for riders and businesses across Nigeria, the UK, US, and Canada.

Loca8tor (by Workerholics Solutions Ltd) generates 1km-grid postcodes for Nigeria and reverse-geocodes addresses for UK/US/CA. It includes live delivery tracking, a rider app with proof-of-delivery, business fleet tools, and a location quiz with rewards.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Loca8tor postcode generation and delivery features.
- [Generate Postcode](/generate): Generate a shareable postcode from your current location.
- [Search Postcode](/search): Look up a postcode and view it on a map.
- [Live Map](/map): Interactive map of generated postcodes and points of interest.
- [Track Delivery](/track): Customer-facing live delivery tracking by code.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Standard, and business plans with FAQs.
- [API Docs](/api-docs): Developer reference for postcode and geolocation endpoints.
- [Quiz](/quiz): Location knowledge quiz with airtime/data rewards.
- [Refer & Earn](/refer): Invite friends and earn referral credit.
- [Contact](/contact): Send a support query or sales inquiry.
